text:
Morgan: Hey support — customer's invoice shows ~120 extra tokens per call compared to our SDK and a quick API repro.
Priya: Can you paste the curl you used? streaming or non-streaming?
Morgan: Non-streaming generate. Minimal curl below.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer XXX" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-compact-v1","input":"Summarize this...","stream":false}'
```
Morgan: API response body included `usage.tokens.total: 84`.
Morgan: Our SDK estimator log shows `estimate: 50` for the same prompt. Customer invoice line shows ~200 tokens billed per request.
Tom: Are there any system messages or tool calls? server can inject things after client send.
Morgan: We included the system prompt in the estimate. Customer isn't calling tools.
Emma: I saw a related case — runtime performs a post-run moderation/classification pass which can add tokens but those tokens are only added to metering, not echoed in the `usage` object in the primary response.
Sean: billing-bot: metering trace 0xabc123 attached — server emitted header `x-metering-postrun: 118` for that trace :warning: 
Priya: Can we get full response headers? any `x-injected-*` headers?
Morgan: Response headers we captured:
``
x-request-id: 0xabc123
x-metering-postrun: 118
x-model-tokens: 84
```
Ana (eng-runtime): Confirmation: the runtime returns the model-visible token usage in `usage` (what users see for generation), while post-run tooling (moderation, safety classifiers, rerank) runs after generation and its tokens are accounted in metering and invoices but not merged into the `usage` field historically. That gap is intentional but confusing.
Morgan: So invoice = model tokens + postrun tool tokens, SDK estimate ~= model tokens only → explains invoice > SDK.
Tom: Short repro for engineering: call generate (stream=false), then query meter trace endpoint with request id and you'll see `postrun_tool_tokens`.
Emma: Quick mitigation: runtime will add a diagnostic header `x-metering-debug: postrun=118` when `metering_debug=true`. We'll flip on for affected customers.
Priya: SDK fix idea: when header `x-metering-postrun` present, log a warning and expose `postrun_tokens` on `client.estimate()` so client-side tools can approximate billed tokens. Filing INF-492.
billing-team: Please attach the customer traces (request ids) and we'll reconcile. If charges are surprising, we'll issue credit while we improve clarity.
billing-bot: Created Incident 2026-03-METER-47, assigned to billing-team.
Morgan: I've added two customer traces and the curl repro to the ticket.
Ana: Longer term plan: change API `usage` shape to `usage.breakdown = { model_tokens, system_injected_tokens, postrun_tool_tokens }` so response, docs, SDKs, and invoices line up.
Emma: Roadmap: diagnostic header this week, SDK warning next week, full `usage.breakdown` change in ~2 sprints.
Priya: Thanks — I'll update customer and keep this thread open until billing confirms credits.
Morgan: Ack. Thanks all :thumbsup:
